stops.note: to grow again, to increase, from re- (again) and crescere (to grow)
narrowed in French to mean new troops raised to replenish an army
stops.meaning: new troops raised to replenish an army

stops.note: settled as the English word for a newly enlisted member of an organization
stops.meaning: a newly enlisted member of an organization or force

current_meaning: a person newly enlisted into an organization, especially the armed forces
